inferred_profile.contents_definition: CONTENTS are the specific details and descriptions of each tool as opposed to METADATA which includes only identifiers and counts.

deterministic_rules: sensitivity = LLM classification against the org POLICY (classify -> map; the org supplies no numbers)
tool impact = deterministic ladder (static_impact.py); the v4 impact prompt decides only where the ladder abstains (confidence < 0.5)
alias twins (DEPRECATED -> canonical): max blast per asset
bulk twin blast: blast(bulk) > blast(singular) per asset (+1 on tie, cap 5)
blast roof: REMOVED in this mode (a cap can only under-score)
bands: band_label_v5 — pure score thresholds on the 0-125 scale (low <17, medium 17-49, high 50-99, critical >=100); no categorical overrides, so a band is explainable from its own score

blast_escape_evidence.install_skill|server-capability-install: Installs new capability into the running server (loss axis: I>A>C)
blast_escape_evidence.install_skill|platform-catalogs: Catalog listings are Routine. Anything that installs capability into the server is Restricted and a hub.
blast_escape_evidence.equity_screener|screening-and-fanout: A single call that fans out into a large provider query is Restricted on the availability axis alone — the provider budget is shared by the whole team.

This operation is not limited in scope but rather encompasses an entire set of actions that result in the creation and registration of a new skill. Therefore, it falls under the category of 'ordinary write' (4).
